title: Assessing Personalized AI Mentoring with Large Language Models in the Computing Field

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot LLM responses to career mentoring questions across different racial and ethnic student profiles (African American, White, Hispanic) using an NLP semantic similarity pipeline and human evaluation to see if social backgrounds are appropriately considered.

Comparing zero-shot LLM responses to career mentoring questions across different gender identities (Male, Female) embedded in student profiles, evaluated via semantic similarity metrics and human surveys.

Evaluating how LLMs tailor mentoring advice based on a student's educational experience level and major (e.g., Junior in Computer Science vs. Undecided Freshman) using a custom natural language processing similarity analysis and qualitative human assessment.
